{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not account for the added thickness of the I.Z.B.P. plating; after plating the hole will be undersize and may not accept its mating shaft. The designer should either increase the pre-plate bore size to allow for the coating thickness or add a note requiring re-machining/masking of the bore after plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Increase the pre-plate bore size by twice the maximum plating thickness, or add a note such as 'Mask ⌀16 H7 bore during plating' or 'Re-machine ⌀16 H7 bore after plating'."}]}
